CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ck261_raw_20261026_211659.erasures  (

Label: schema
SQL:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ck261_raw_20261026_211659.engagement_segments  (
    tenant LowCardinality(String),
    content_kind LowCardinality(String),
    content_id String,
    content_version_id String,
    subject_kind LowCardinality(String),
    subject String,
    receipt_id String,
    revision UInt64,
    visit_id String,
    segment_id String,
    occurred_at DateTime64(6, 'UTC'),
    active_ms UInt32,
    covered_units Array(UInt32),
    unit_attention Map(UInt32, UInt64),
    unit_total UInt32,
    unit_scale UInt32,
    resume String,
    access_context String,
    measurement String,
    version UInt128 DEFAULT bitOr(bitShiftLeft(toUInt128(revision),64),toUInt128(cityHash64(visit_id,segment_id,occurred_at,active_ms,covered_units,unit_attention,unit_total,unit_scale,resume,access_context,measurement))),
    ingested_at DateTime64(6, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(6),
    INDEX idx_engagement_subject (subject_kind,subject) TYPE bloom_filter GRANULARITY 4
)
ENGINE = ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{database}/{table}', '{replica}', version)
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(occurred_at)
ORDER BY (tenant,content_kind,content_id,content_version_id,subject_kind,subject,receipt_id)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;

ORDER BY (tenant, content_kind, subject_kind, subject, observation_id)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;

SQL:
INSERT INTO ck261_raw_20261026_211659.popularity_daily
 (tenant,content_kind,domain,language,day,content_id,readers,eligible,version)
 WITH canonical AS (
 SELECT content_id,content_version_id,subject_kind,subject,receipt_id,
 argMax(tuple(active_ms,notEmpty(covered_units),access_context),version) AS fact
 FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.engagement_segments
 WHERE tenant=? AND content_kind=? AND occurred_at>=? AND occurred_at<? AND (sipHash128(concat(subject_kind, ':', subject)), tenant) NOT IN (SELECT subject_hash, tenant FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.erasures)
 GROUP BY content_id,content_version_id,subject_kind,subject,receipt_id
 ), people AS (
 SELECT subject_kind,subject,groupUniqArrayArrayIf(eligible_tiers,eligibility_known) AS tiers
 FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.measured_population_observations
 WHERE tenant=? AND content_kind=? AND observed_at>=? AND observed_at<? AND (sipHash128(concat(subject_kind, ':', subject)), tenant) NOT IN (SELECT subject_hash, tenant FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.erasures)
 AND (?='' OR domain=?) AND (?='' OR language=?) GROUP BY subject_kind,subject
 ), qualified AS (
 SELECT r.content_id AS content_id,r.content_version_id AS content_version_id,r.subject_kind AS subject_kind,r.subject AS subject
 FROM canonical r INNER JOIN contentkit_daily_audiences a ON r.content_id=a.content_id
 INNER JOIN people p ON p.subject_kind=r.subject_kind AND p.subject=r.subject
 WHERE JSONExtractString(r.fact.3,'viewer_access')='full'
 AND (?='' OR JSONExtractString(r.fact.3,'domain')=?) AND (?='' OR JSONExtractString(r.fact.3,'language')=?)
 AND (a.public=1 OR hasAny(p.tiers,a.tiers))
 GROUP BY r.content_id,r.content_version_id,r.subject_kind,r.subject
 HAVING sum(toUInt64(r.fact.1))>=1000 AND max(r.fact.2)>0
 ), readers AS (
 SELECT content_id,uniqExact(tuple(subject_kind,subject)) AS readers FROM qualified GROUP BY content_id
 ), cohorts AS (SELECT DISTINCT audience,public,tiers FROM contentkit_daily_audiences), population AS (
 SELECT a.audience,count() AS eligible FROM cohorts a CROSS JOIN people p
 WHERE a.public=1 OR hasAny(p.tiers,a.tiers) GROUP BY a.audience
 )
 SELECT ?,?,?,?,toDate(?),a.content_id,coalesce(r.readers,0),coalesce(p.eligible,0),toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6)))
 FROM contentkit_daily_audiences a LEFT JOIN readers r USING(content_id) LEFT JOIN population p USING(audience)
 SETTINGS max_threads=2, max_execution_time=120, max_memory_usage=1073741824,
 max_bytes_before_external_group_by=134217728, max_bytes_before_external_sort=134217728

INSERT INTO ck261_raw_20261026_211659.popularity_daily
 (tenant,content_kind,domain,language,day,content_id,readers,eligible,version)
 WITH canonical AS (
 SELECT content_id,content_version_id,subject_kind,subject,receipt_id,
 argMax(tuple(active_ms,notEmpty(covered_units),access_context),version) AS fact
 FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.engagement_segments
 WHERE tenant=? AND content_kind=? AND occurred_at>=? AND occurred_at<? AND (sipHash128(concat(subject_kind, ':', subject)), tenant) NOT IN (SELECT subject_hash, tenant FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.erasures)
 GROUP BY content_id,content_version_id,subject_kind,subject,receipt_id
 ), people AS (
 SELECT subject_kind,subject,groupUniqArrayArrayIf(eligible_tiers,eligibility_known) AS tiers
 FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.measured_population_observations
 WHERE tenant=? AND content_kind=? AND observed_at>=? AND observed_at<? AND (sipHash128(concat(subject_kind, ':', subject)), tenant) NOT IN (SELECT subject_hash, tenant FROM ck261_raw_20261026_211659.erasures)
 AND (?='' OR domain=?) AND (?='' OR language=?) GROUP BY subject_kind,subject
 ), qualified AS (
 SELECT r.content_id AS content_id,r.content_version_id AS content_version_id,r.subject_kind AS subject_kind,r.subject AS subject
 FROM canonical r INNER JOIN contentkit_daily_audiences a ON r.content_id=a.content_id
 INNER JOIN people p ON p.subject_kind=r.subject_kind AND p.subject=r.subject
 WHERE JSONExtractString(r.fact.3,'viewer_access')='full'
 AND (?='' OR JSONExtractString(r.fact.3,'domain')=?) AND (?='' OR JSONExtractString(r.fact.3,'language')=?)
 AND (a.public=1 OR hasAny(p.tiers,a.tiers))
 GROUP BY r.content_id,r.content_version_id,r.subject_kind,r.subject
 HAVING sum(toUInt64(r.fact.1))>=1000 AND max(r.fact.2)>0
 ), readers AS (
 SELECT content_id,uniqExact(tuple(subject_kind,subject)) AS readers FROM qualified GROUP BY content_id
 ), cohorts AS (SELECT DISTINCT audience,public,tiers FROM contentkit_daily_audiences), population AS (
 SELECT a.audience,count() AS eligible FROM cohorts a CROSS JOIN people p
 WHERE a.public=1 OR hasAny(p.tiers,a.tiers) GROUP BY a.audience
 )
 SELECT ?,?,?,?,toDate(?),a.content_id,coalesce(r.readers,0),coalesce(p.eligible,0),toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6)))
 FROM contentkit_daily_audiences a LEFT JOIN readers r USING(content_id) LEFT JOIN population p USING(audience)
 SETTINGS max_threads=2, max_execution_time=120, max_memory_usage=1073741824,
 max_bytes_before_external_group_by=134217728, max_bytes_before_external_sort=134217728
